column1: # Matched RV32/RV64 ML-KEM-768 comparison from source commit d2941e5dc.
# half-bank NTT. Hardware enables only NTT and the pointer Keccak PE. Software
# uses KECCAK=pe NTT=reg32 NTTBF=ise NTTMUL=ise ARITH=all ARITH_MUL=ise
# SERIAL=1. Both XLEN builds use LLVM 20.1.8 at Vortex commit 4c836512a60c.
# Device cycles include the complete launch; batch_makespan excludes
# launch/setup/readback. The RV32 and RV64 SimX rows are the XLEN comparison.
# RTL and XRT rows validate the RV64 M1 timing model and full AFU integration.
